blocks.name: What is examined in the CIE IGCSE Business Paper 1?

blocks.text: What is examined in the CIE IGCSE Business Paper 1?

blocks.md:
- This paper is made up of** four questions** requiring a mixture of** short** **answers **and **structured data responses**
- Each question starts with a **short case study**, to which you should refer when answer the question parts that follow
- The paper's duration is 90 minutes
- The total number of marks available is **80,** representing** 50%** **of the qualification**
- You must answer all questions

- In **each **of the **four questions:**

  - **Part a** is worth 2 marks
  
    - You are usually required to either
    
      - **Define **a key term
      - Carry out a simple **calculation**
      - **State **or **identify **two factors, features, ways or impacts
    - Advice on answering 2-mark questions can be found [here](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/business/cie/25/revision-notes/7-exam-technique/7-3-structuring-your-responses/answering-2-mark-questions/)
  - **Part b **is worth 4 marks
  
    - You are usually required to either
    
      - **Outline** two factors
      - Carry out a multi-stage **calculation**
      - **State **or **identify **four factors, factors, features, ways or impacts
    - Advice on answering 4-mark questions can be found [here](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/business/cie/25/revision-notes/7-exam-technique/7-3-structuring-your-responses/answering-4-mark-questions/)
  - **Part c** is worth 6 marks
  
    - You are required to explain either
    
      - Two advantages and two disadvantages of a given issue
      - Four reasons, ways or impacts of a given issue
    - Advice on answering 6-mark questions can be found [here](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/business/cie/25/revision-notes/7-exam-technique/7-3-structuring-your-responses/answering-6-mark-questions/)
  - **Part d** is worth 8 marks
  
    - You are required to either
    
      - Make a judgement about the significance of two or more factors
      - Make a recommendation about a suitable course of action
    - Advice on answering 6-mark questions can be found [here](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/business/cie/25/revision-notes/7-exam-technique/7-3-structuring-your-responses/answering-12-mark-questions/)
